ux_intent: Validate that the six highlight colours are identifiable by name — not by colour index — so that colour-blind users and screen-reader users can select and confirm the correct highlight without ambiguity.
figma_make_prompt:
Build an ebook highlight colour picker overlay for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: mobile (iOS and Android), 390x844 base frame.
No top app bar. The overlay appears as a bottom sheet with a drag handle at the top centre.

Layout:
- Bottom sheet: auto height, minimum 180dp. Top corners 16px radius. Background #FFFFFF. Drop shadow above.
- Header row: "Highlight Style" (Body Large, 16sp, weight 600, #121212) left-aligned with 16px left padding. Close button (X) right-aligned, 48x48dp touch target.
- Colour grid: 2 rows × 3 columns, centred, 16px gap between items. Each colour button:
  - Circle 48x48dp, filled with the colour.
  - Text label directly beneath the circle (Caption, 12sp, #121212): colour name.
  - Touch target: 48x48dp around the circle (the circle itself is the touch target).
  - Selected state: 3px ring in primary #6366F1 around the circle. Label becomes weight 600.
- Colours and labels in order (left to right, top to bottom): Yellow (#FACC15), Blue (#60A5FA), Green (#34D399), Orange (#FB923C), Pink (#F472B6), Purple (#A78BFA).
- Footer: two full-width buttons with 8px gap — "Apply" (primary filled, 48dp) and "Cancel" (secondary outlined, 48dp).

States:
- Default: no colour selected. All circles in normal state. Apply button disabled (50 % opacity).
- Colour selected: selected circle has the 3px primary ring, its label is bold. Apply button enabled (full opacity).
- Applied: bottom sheet dismisses. A brief success toast "Highlight applied" appears at the bottom of the screen (auto-dismiss after 2 seconds).

Behavior:
- Tap a colour circle → select it (ring appears, label boldens), enable Apply.
- Tap Apply → dismiss sheet, show toast.
- Tap Cancel or drag sheet down → dismiss sheet, no highlight applied.

Style:
- Light. Material 3-ish. Background #FFFFFF. Primary #6366F1. Labels #121212. Auto layout.

First step: default state with all six colour circles and their labels visible, no colour selected, and the Apply button in its disabled state.
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the highlight colour picker is displayed
When the user views the colour options
Then each of the six circles has a distinct text label beneath it naming the colour

Given no colour is selected
When the user views the Apply button
Then it is visually disabled (50 % opacity) and does not respond to taps

Given the user taps a colour circle
When the selection updates
Then that circle shows a 3px primary ring, its label becomes bold, and the Apply button becomes enabled

Given the user taps Apply after selecting a colour
When the action completes
Then the sheet dismisses and a success toast confirms the highlight was applied
manual_validation_checklist: Verify all six colour circles have text labels: Yellow, Blue, Green, Orange, Pink, Purple — no index numbers
Measure each colour circle touch target: ≥ 48x48dp
Confirm label text is Caption 12sp, #121212 on #FFFFFF background — contrast ≥ 4.5:1
Check selected-state ring (3px primary) is visible against each colour fill
Verify Apply button is visually distinct when disabled (50 % opacity) vs enabled (full opacity)
Confirm the drag handle is present at the top centre of the bottom sheet
